subject: PUBLIC TRANS
bill.title: Establishes "NJpass Program" to provide discounted fares to eligible organizations; establishes "GO NJ Transit Card Program" to develop transit cards that can be used to purchase any NJT service.

action.description: Reported and Referred to Assembly Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🚌 Transportation
NJ A2329 — NJ Could Offer Big Discounts on Transit for Training Programs

New Jersey is considering a new program called the ‘NJpass Program’ to give discounted New Jersey Transit fares to organizations that train people – like apprenticeship programs and workforce development centers. The NJ Transit Corporation would partner with these organizations to offer discounted tickets to their ‘approved classes. ...
